title: refactor(components)!: the sidebar node supplies its own provider; retire the ten sidebar-* primitives; the sidebar documents teach the node (objectui#10859 batch 8, phase 2d)
body:
Part of #10859

Clause-②: yes

Phase 2d of batch 8 on the family card, under "Fork 3" of the seat's fork ruling `5948252391` (route A, conditional). The `sidebar` registration now mounts its own `SidebarProvider` only when no provider is above it. The four `components-basic-sidebar` catalog documents and `sidebar.mdx` teach that node. The `sidebar` registration honours the spec's boolean `collapsible`. The ten `sidebar-*` primitives retire. Implemented by `os-dev` for `domain:ui` seat 1, session `session_01YLg8XqWGJ785fwQ5v4pH37`. Base: `origin/main` `5988b6b53`. Main was merged after objectui#11457 (phase 2c) landed as `ad1785c1d`, and again after objectui#11458 landed; neither merge touched this PR's files. objectui#11441 (PR objectui#11460) landed first, so on the merged base this PR moves the ratchet 18 → 8.

## Premise, verified first: safe detection exists

shadcn's `useSidebar()` throws outside a provider, and its context is private to the primitive. The primitive gains `useOptionalSidebar()`, a non-throwing read that returns `null` exactly where `useSidebar()` would throw. It is added as a **declared local patch** in `scripts/shadcn-local-patches.mjs` (two anchored edits on registry bytes: the reader and its export). The no-touch rule for `src/ui/**` is kept. The SDUI node wraps only when that read returns `null`.

Both cases from the ruling were measured through the real `SchemaRenderer`. A provider is counted by its `group/sidebar-wrapper` element.

| host | providers in the tree | whose state drives the node |
|:--|:--|:--|
| bare (no provider) | 1, the node's own | the node's own provider (expanded) |
| controlled `SidebarProvider`, `open` false then true | 1, the host's | the host: `data-state` goes from `collapsed` to `expanded` |
| `@object-ui/layout` `AppShell` with `defaultOpen` false and a `SidebarTrigger` in its navbar | 1, the shell's | the shell: starts `collapsed`, and clicking "Toggle Sidebar" makes it `expanded` |

The tests that pin these cases are `sidebar-node-provider-10859.test.tsx` in `@object-ui/components` and `app-shell-sidebar-node-one-provider-10859.test.tsx` in `@object-ui/layout`. Ablation 1 below forces the detection off, and every host-with-provider row goes red. There is no fork, so neither fallback route (B or C) is used.

## `collapsible`: the boolean is honoured

`false` maps to shadcn's `'none'`: the in-flow, fixed-width form, which ignores the open state. `true` or an absent key passes no prop, so shadcn keeps the default the node applied before (`offcanvas`). Before this change, the boolean reached the DOM verbatim as `data-collapsible="true"` / `"false"`, which no rule matches. A render pins each value (`false` → in-flow; `true` / absent → `offcanvas`; never the verbatim boolean). Any other value is forwarded unchanged, as before, and `objectui validate` refuses it as `invalid_type` at `collapsible` (measured for `'none'` and `'icon'`). The registration's `collapsible` input is now declared as a boolean. Its `defaultProps` no longer name `collapsible`: that `'icon'` was never read at render, because `SchemaRenderer` does not read a registration's `defaultProps`.

## The teaching: four documents and `sidebar.mdx`

Each document is now one `{ "type": "sidebar", "collapsible": false, "children": [...] }` node, with armed children:
- `basic-sidebar` and `grouped-sidebar`: `text` headings and ghost `button` items, and in `grouped-sidebar` a `separator` between the groups;
- `collapsible-sidebar`: three `button` items;
- `sidebar-with-badges`: `flex` rows with their children in `properties` (objectui#11276), each holding a `text` node and a `badge` node. The 6806 pins ("Inbox12", "Drafts3", two labelled badges) still hold.

The documents author `collapsible: false` because that is the one form that draws in every host. The docs-site hosts mount their provider with `defaultOpen={false}`, so a collapsible-form document starts collapsed and off-canvas there. `collapsible-sidebar` keeps its id. Its curated title is now "Non-Collapsible Sidebar", with a description, because the old title named a behaviour the document does not show.

**Measured by a render:** `sidebar-node-docs-10859.test.tsx` renders each document bare and inside the docs-host shape (`SidebarProvider` with `min-h-0 w-full` and `defaultOpen={false}`). In both shapes the test checks exactly one provider, the in-flow form, every authored string, and no diagnostic panel.

**Measured in a browser:** the real renderer's markup was compiled with the repo's Tailwind 4.3.3 and laid out in Chromium at 1280×800. `basic-sidebar` occupies x 16 to 272, 256 px wide and hit-testable, both bare and in the docs host. At 375 px the same holds.

**Measured by `objectui validate`:** the built CLI's `validate` command returns exit 0, "Schema is valid!", for all four documents. As a control, the base `basic-sidebar.json` returns exit 1, `invalid_union` at `type`. The strict face (`StrictAnyComponentSchema`) accepts all four too.

**`sidebar.mdx`** now describes the node and the two `collapsible` values, and its Schema block is a typed `SidebarSchema` literal. That literal validates on both faces. `check:doc-snippets` judges it: with `collapsible` set to `'none'`, the gate reported 1 failed block, a TS2322 on that line, and at head it reports 0 failed. The page no longer lists the `items` / `groups` keys, which no face declares.

## Retirement: the ten `sidebar-*` primitives

The premise gate was re-measured at `origin/main` `ad1785c1d` / `4a1adb76e` and objectstack `origin/main` `ecb6ca02`, at a type position, for both spellings:
- objectui producers: only the four catalog documents, which are rewritten here.
- objectstack: 0.
- Runtime emission (computed `sidebar-` keys): 0 in either repo.

`sidebar-provider`, `sidebar-header`, `sidebar-content`, `sidebar-group`, `sidebar-menu`, `sidebar-menu-item`, `sidebar-menu-button`, `sidebar-footer`, `sidebar-inset` and `sidebar-trigger` are unregistered, with their `ui:` twins. One tombstone docblock in `renderers/navigation/sidebar.tsx` describes the retired calls without quoting them, so the node-slot source reader does not mistake them for live calls. The shadcn components behind the ten stay exported for JSX.

Tests that named the retired keys moved with them:
- The DOM-leak sweep loses 10 targets (150 / 82 / 68 for `components`; 168 targets and 84 rows overall), and its count prose follows. The "`ui:sidebar-trigger` is CLEAN" case goes, because there is no registration left to sweep; the ratchet pins the absence.
- `sidebar-trigger-dom-leak-5632.test.tsx` is deleted with its subject. The sweep's historical note gains a dated line.
- In the form-control leak census, `sidebar-menu-button` leaves and `button` goes from 116 to 127 (the new items). In the layout leak census, `flex` goes from 248 to 252, `text` from 699 / 155 to 687 / 140 and `box` from 86 to 82. Each move has a comment explaining it.
- The container-declaration census drops both sidebar context probes. `sidebar` now renders its child under the bare probe, and that is asserted. The ruled-family row is now `button`, `badge`, `alert` and `sidebar`.
- The `sidebar-group` inline-locale read-site cases go, with a dated note. The body-dialect census pin now reads the one remaining registration.
- `shadcn-local-patches.test.ts` filters the cookie family by issue and adds the optional-context family.

## Ratchet

| pin | before | after | what moved |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `REFUSED_AT_TYPE` (bare) | 18 | **8** | the ten `sidebar-*` keys |
| `NAMESPACED_REFUSED_AT_TYPE` | 372 | **362** | the ten `ui:sidebar-*` twins |

`STILL_REFUSED_10859` now holds the 8 the ruling kept (objectui#11440), and its set-equality row holds. objectui#11441's row and this phase's row both stay. A new phase-2d row checks three things: the ten keys are out of the population and still refused at `type`, their twins are gone, and `sidebar` is registered and not refused. `ui:sidebar` is still registered, and it stays among the namespaced keys objectui#10872 counts as refused, so the row asserts only that it is present. The namespaced non-vacuity floor goes from 400 to 350 (391 keys now), with a comment. ⛔ Neither pin rises. objectui#11441 landed first, so this PR merged `main` (`ed54d285c`) and re-pinned at `2095abad1`.

## Changesets

- `@object-ui/components`, `minor`, BREAKING (authoring): the ten keys, with a migration per spelling. Each target was measured to validate on both faces: `sidebar` with `className`; `button` with `variant: "ghost"`; `text`; `separator`; a `flex` row holding `text` and `badge`; and a `flex` row holding the `sidebar` node and a `box`.
- `@object-ui/components`, `minor`: the provider detection, the `collapsible` mapping and the new `useOptionalSidebar` export.
- `@object-ui/cli`, `minor`, BREAKING (authoring): the regenerated known-types list.

`layout`, `app-shell` and `example-schema-catalog` changed test files or private content only. Five pending entries gain dated notes: 11347, `5632-sidebar-trigger-dom-passthrough`, 6771, 9910 and `form-control-renderers-dom-props-5632`. Each note is a pure append.

## Reverse verification

The predictions were written before any leg ran.

**BASE leg.** Ten source files went back to `4a1adb76e`: the renderer, the primitive, the patch list, the known-types list, the four documents, `catalog-meta.json` and `index.ts`. The 7 pins ran against them.
- **Predicted:** 32 red, as 6 + 0 + 16 + 2 + 4 + at least 2 + 1 across the seven pins. The AppShell pin stays green, because base never wrapped.
- **First run:** 31 red. The one short was the `collapsible: false` row: on base it rendered nothing (a bare throw), and nothing has no `data-collapsible` either. The rows now assert that the node drew before reading its form (commit `000ce424c`).
- **Re-run:** `Tests 32 failed | 104 passed (136)`, exactly as predicted. The AppShell pin was green.
- **Restored:** 10 blobs equal HEAD, `git diff HEAD` is 0 lines, and status is 0 lines.

**Ablation 1: provider detection forced off** (the node always wraps). The anchor went from 1 hit to 0, and the blob from `3141c810ecba` to `b66caf1c8051`.
- **Predicted:** 7 red, all host-with-provider rows (2 in the node pin, 1 AppShell, 4 docs-host).
- **Observed:** `Tests 7 failed | 18 passed (25)`, exactly those 7. No bare-host row moved.

**Ablation 2: `collapsible` mapping removed** (the authored value forwarded verbatim). The blob went from `3141c810ecba` to `72f62c65ab53`.
- **Predicted:** 12 red (4 in the node pin, 8 in the docs pin), with AppShell green.
- **Observed:** `Tests 12 failed | 13 passed (25)`, exactly those 12.

Both ablations ran through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, with a trap restore of their own. **Restored:** blob `3141c810ecba` equals HEAD and `git diff HEAD` is empty after each leg.

## Acceptance notes

- **The collapsible form is off-screen on desktop while expanded (out of scope, reported to the seat).** shadcn's `offcanvas` rules (the gap's `w-0` and the container's negative `left` / `right`) are not qualified by state. The repository's undeclared local edit (3) keeps `data-collapsible` set while expanded, where upstream blanks it. So an expanded off-canvas sidebar sits off-screen at md and wider. That falsifies the edit's "same result" note in `shadcn-components.json`.
  - Chromium, 1280 px, with the real markup and Tailwind 4.3.3: a bare `{ type: 'sidebar' }` (collapsible absent or `true`, expanded) sits at x −256 to −1, out of the viewport. The same markup with the attribute blanked as upstream does sits at x 0 to 255. A `collapsible="icon"` sidebar, whose rules are qualified, sits at x 0 to 255.
  - Every in-repo JSX host uses `icon`. The taught documents author `false`. This PR keeps the ruling's "`true` or absent → the current default". `sidebar.mdx` describes the collapsible form only as positioned against the viewport and does not claim that it opens visibly.
- **Declared but not drawn.** `SidebarSchema` declares `title`, `nav`, `content`, `footer`, `position`, `defaultCollapsed`, `collapsed`, `width`, `collapsedWidth` and a `variant` enum that differs from shadcn's. All of these validate on both faces, but the renderer reads only `collapsible`, `children` and `className`, and spreads the rest onto shadcn. `@object-ui/types`' README still teaches `sidebar.nav`. This belongs to the same "declared means enforced" family as `collapsible`; the docs here teach only what is read.
- `sidebar.mdx` now teaches `collapsible: false` throughout. The ruling's sentence "a bare `sidebar` node draws visibly in any host" holds for that form, measured in jsdom and Chromium. For the collapsible form it is limited by the first note.
